thread:
nina: Quick experimental ask for next week's pricing push — can we run a hero vs modal estimator test + a minimal FAQ tweak and compare lead routes? Need fast signal before webinar.
arjun: Sounds good. Define "hero" placement? Full-width compact widget in the hero with 'Try estimate' CTA?
claire: Yes — hero widget (inline) vs modal-prompt after user clicks "See pricing". Modal includes short calc + contact checkbox.
leo: UX note: modal should pre-fill region selector from geo; keep results copy concise. I'll build mocks tonight.
paula: Routing idea: if estimate > $1,000/mo OR user checks "Request SLA pricing" then tag as "sales_sdr" and create lead in HubSpot. Otherwise tag "marketing_nurture" and add to webinar follow-up flow.
nina: Good thresholds. Also test tier-name variant across the two placements to see interaction effects. Two name sets: Set 1 = "Core / Scale / Enterprise"; Set 2 = "Starter / Teams / Enterprise". Keep prices unchanged.
arjun: Metrics: estimator impressions, estimator CTR, estimate submissions, demo requests, MQLs, and webinar RSVP rate uplift. Also run geo split EU vs NA.
claire: Minimal FAQ change: add one line under "How estimates are calculated" with a short bullets + anchor id #estimate-method so we can deep-link. Avoid touching other FAQ copy.
leo: Instrumentation events: estimator_shown, estimator_cta_click, estimator_submit, estimator_value_bucket (e.g. >1000), faq_anchor_click, route_assigned. Payload example I put in tracking doc: ```{ "placement":"modal", "variant":"starter-teams", "estimate_usd": 1250 }```
paula: On routing: HubSpot mapping fields: lead_source=pricing_estimator, interest_tier=Scale, priority=High/Normal. I'll draft the mapping and API snippet.
analytics-bot: experiment.create id=pricing-hero-modal-4445006789 cohorts=2 start=4445060000 end=4445280000 note="exclude existing paying customers"
nina: Who's owning rollout? Claire for mocks, Leo for front-end, Arjun for experiment config, Paula for lead mapping, analytics for dashboard. Timeline: mocks today, front-end dev tomorrow, QA Thu, launch Fri. Tight but doable.
arjun: Audience filters: exclude paid accounts, internal IP ranges, and org admins. Include only new visitors & freemium signups.
claire: I put Figma frames here: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/pricing-hero-modal-estimator — frames H1/H2/M1.
leo: I'll add small microcopy change on modal: "Estimate only; final price via sales." and a low-visual footprint on mobile.
paula: Sales 1-pager: I'll create a short one with expected uplift bands and routing notes. Share by EOD.
analytics-bot: dashboard.created name=PricingEstimatorQuickView datasource=page_events panel=estimator_ctrs
nina: Great. Quick reminder: keep experiment names and tags consistent so post-experiment analysis isn't a mess. We'll reconvene 1pm if blockers. :sparkles:
